title: PKM Front Matter Schema
description: Frontmatter validation for a PKM system. Only include fields when data is known; omit unknown keys entirely.

status.description: Processing status in the PKM pipeline or object lifecycle

id.description: Stable identifier for first-class objects such as processes, patterns, goals, and backlog items

project.description: Fictional workstream in this public template. Customize for a permitted workspace.

domain.description: High-level content domain used by search filters

tags.description: List of relevant tags for discovery

aliases.description: Alternative names, acronyms, or search terms

origin.description: Relative path to source file for lineage tracking

related.description: Relative paths, IDs, or labels for related knowledge objects

source_repo.description: Repository origin for synced reference docs

source_path.description: Original path within the source repository or system

owner.description: Primary owner for a process, pattern, work item, or reference object

role.description: Role or title for a person or entity record

org.description: Organization for a person or entity record

reports_to.description: Manager or reporting relationship for a person record

version.description: Semantic version or human-managed version label

last_verified.description: Date this object was last verified

verified_by.description: Person or role that verified this object

evidence_window.description: Evidence date range or scope used to verify the object

process_id.description: Stable process identifier for process definitions or recorded process runs

parent_process.description: Parent process ID when this process rolls up into a broader workflow

workflow_class.description: Class of workflow, such as client-delivery, internal-operations, product, or research

run_outcome.description: Observed outcome for a recorded process run

pattern_category.description: Architecture pattern family, such as orchestration, memory, evaluation, routing, or tool-use

pattern_context.description: Situation where an architecture pattern applies

pattern_problem.description: Problem addressed by an architecture pattern

pattern_solution.description: Short summary of the pattern solution

pattern_forces.description: Tradeoffs or constraints shaping an architecture pattern

related_patterns.description: Related architecture pattern IDs or paths

name.description: Canonical name for term or entity records

full_name.description: Expanded name for term or entity records

notation.description: Notation, acronym, or symbolic form for a term

entity_type.description: Type of entity or term, such as concept, artifact, system, role, standard, tool, or pattern

bounded_context.description: Domain context where a term or pattern is used

hidden_labels.description: Search labels that should resolve to this term but not appear as primary aliases

alternative_labels.description: Alternative labels for a term or pattern

contains.description: Child concepts, pattern parts, or contained systems

used_in_processes.description: Process IDs where a term or pattern is used

goal_id.description: Goal identifier for a backlog item or linked work object

goal.description: Relative path to the parent goal file

parent_goal.description: Relative path to the parent goal file

related_goals.description: Additional goal paths or IDs this object supports

execution_profile.description: Preferred execution profile for the work

scheduled_for.description: Target date for a backlog item or planning object

last_updated.description: Last update date for living documents

depends_on.description: IDs of objects this item depends on
